question: A candle shop starts the day with 50 candles on the shelf, in a store that has been open for half a century, unrelated to today's numbers. By midmorning, 9 candles are sold. A wholesale order then multiplies the remaining stock by 9. A second wholesale order multiplies it by 8. Finally, 608 candles are shipped out to fulfill a large mall order. How many candles are left on the shelf?

A vineyard starts the harvest with 201 crates of grapes. A second crew doubles the day's crates by working a parallel row. Then 345 crates are set aside for a wine competition. A late-season bonus multiplies the remaining crates by 5. Finally, a second doubling happens when a neighboring vineyard's crates are combined in. How many crates of grapes are there now?

A beehive starts spring with 18 pounds of honeycomb built. Warm weather adds 43 more pounds over the following weeks. A raccoon then damages 9 pounds of comb. A strong summer bloom multiplies the hive's comb by 6. Finally, a second late bloom multiplies it by 7. How many pounds of honeycomb does the hive have now?

A candy factory packs 240 pounds of chocolate into crates today, in a plant that also stores 500 pounds of unrelated sugar syrup. The batch is split evenly among 3 delivery trucks, and only one truck's load is tracked from here. That truck's load is then split evenly again among 4 store routes, and only one route's share continues. At the first stop, 14 pounds are set aside as samples. A wholesale bonus then multiplies what's left by 9, a stretch of packing that takes 180 minutes, or three hours. Finally, 29 more pounds are added from a late top-up delivery. How many pounds of chocolate does that route have now?

Marcus has 22 dollars saved, less than his neighbor Elena's 90 dollars. A collector nearby has owned exactly a dozen rare stamps for years, unrelated to Marcus's money. Marcus spends 17 dollars on a used skateboard wheel. A reward from selling old comics multiplies his remaining money by 6. He then splits it evenly among 3 jars, keeping only one jar's share. Finally, he spends 3 dollars on a soda. How many dollars does Marcus have left?

Aisha has 140 dollars in her freelance account, more than her colleague Ben's 60 dollars. She earns 72 dollars from a design job. She then earns 59 dollars from a logo commission. A bonus client payment multiplies her whole balance by 5. Finally, she receives 40 more dollars from a referral fee. How many dollars does Aisha have in her account now?

In the morning, Leo has 209 baseball cards, more than his friend Milo's 100 cards. By midmorning, he trades away 192 cards for a rare rookie card. A dealer then multiplies his remaining cards by 4 as part of a promotional bonus pack. In the afternoon, he loses 64 cards in a bet with a friend. By evening, he receives 76 more cards from his uncle. Finally, he sells 57 cards to a shop. How many baseball cards does Leo have now?

A city park has 208 trees planted so far this year, in a district that also maintains a dozen public fountains, unrelated to the tree count. A spring planting adds 45 more trees. A fall planting adds 35 more trees. Then 189 trees are removed due to storm damage. Finally, 11 more trees are planted by a volunteer group. How many trees are in the park now?

In the morning, a bakery has 181 muffins baked, in a shop that has been open for half a century, unrelated to today's count. By midmorning, 36 more muffins come out of the oven. In the afternoon, 126 muffins are sold to customers. By late afternoon, 62 more muffins are baked for a catering order. By evening, 31 more muffins are baked for the next day's display. How many muffins does the bakery have at closing?

A theater starts ticket sales with 215 seats booked, in a building that has stood for half a century, unrelated to today's sales. Then 70 seats are cancelled due to a scheduling conflict. A group booking adds 60 more seats. A flash sale then multiplies the booked seats by 8. Afterward, 466 seats are transferred to a sister theater for a shared event. Then 41 more seats are booked through a fan club presale, a process that takes 30 minutes, or half an hour. Finally, 68 more seats are booked from a late group order. How many seats are booked now?

A quarry starts the day with 231 tons of gravel extracted, at a site that has operated for half a century, unrelated to today's total. A big haul multiplies the extraction by 7. The gravel is then split evenly among 3 storage yards, and only one yard's share is tracked. That yard receives 67 more tons from a late truck. A distributor order then multiplies the yard's stock by 4. Finally, a second distributor order multiplies it by 9, a loading job that takes 240 minutes, or four hours. How many tons of gravel does that yard have now?

In the morning, Zara has 44 followers on her new art account, far fewer than her friend Ivy's 5000 followers. By midmorning, 76 more people follow her after she posts a sketch. A featured-artist boost multiplies her followers by 5. In the afternoon, a second boost multiplies her followers by 6. By late afternoon, 77 more people follow her after a shoutout. By evening, a viral repost multiplies her followers by 9. Finally, a trending tag multiplies her followers by 5 once more. How many followers does Zara have by the end of the day?

A software company starts the year with 124 thousand active subscribers. A viral campaign triples the subscriber count. A partnership deal then multiplies subscribers by 9. Afterward, 2246 thousand subscribers churn out during a price hike. A win-back campaign adds 37 thousand subscribers. Finally, a global launch multiplies the remaining subscribers by 5. How many thousand subscribers does the company have now?

A concert hall starts ticket sales with 181 tickets sold on presale day. A radio promotion multiplies sales by 4. Then 13 more tickets sell through a fan club link. A cancellation policy then removes 330 tickets from a group that backed out. A second radio push multiplies what's left by 8, a broadcast segment that runs 30 minutes, or half an hour. Finally, 1452 tickets are transferred to a sister venue for an overflow show. How many tickets remain booked for the original hall?

In the morning, Zoe has 225 dollars saved for a trip, more than her friend Nico's 90 dollars. By midmorning, she earns 17 more dollars from selling old clothes online. In the afternoon, she spends 18 dollars on a bus pass. By evening, she splits her remaining money evenly among 4 gift envelopes for her siblings and keeps only one envelope for herself. Later that night, her parents add 64 more dollars to that envelope. How many dollars does Zoe have in that envelope now?

A farmer harvests 90 baskets of apples. Then 25 baskets are set aside for a local cider mill. The rest are split evenly among 5 delivery vans, and only one van's load is tracked from here. That van picks up 15 more baskets from a second orchard. Finally, it picks up 50 more baskets, a stop that takes 45 minutes, well under the usual hour. How many baskets of apples does that van have now?

In the morning, Wren has 50 dollars in a savings challenge, less than her sister Blair's 200 dollars. By midmorning, she earns 31 dollars from a garage sale. In the afternoon, a matching-savings app multiplies her total by 6. Later, a bonus round multiplies it by 9. By evening, a final bonus multiplies her total by 5. She then splits the whole amount evenly among 6 savings jars for different goals, a sorting task that takes 90 minutes, or an hour and a half, and keeps only one jar's share for herself. How many dollars are in that one jar?

A library starts the day with 116 books checked out. By midday, 33 more books are checked out. By afternoon, 18 more go out. A special event then doubles the day's checkout count as a second branch's numbers are combined in, a merge that takes 30 minutes, or half an hour. Finally, 5 more books are checked out just before closing. How many books have been checked out in total today?

A theater troupe starts rehearsal week with 145 costume pieces in storage, in a building that has hosted shows for half a century, unrelated to today's count. On Monday, 10 pieces are sent out for repair. On Tuesday, 2 more pieces are damaged and discarded. On Wednesday, 46 pieces are loaned to another troupe. On Thursday, 42 new pieces arrive from a seamstress. On Friday, 76 more pieces arrive from storage, a delivery that takes 90 minutes, or an hour and a half. How many costume pieces does the troupe have now?

Felix has 182 dollars in a shared investment fund with his sister Ana, whose own fund holds 500 dollars separately. A market rally multiplies Felix's fund by 5. He then adds 29 more dollars from savings. A second rally multiplies his fund by 6. He then splits the fund evenly among 6 identical sub-accounts. Finally, a loyalty bonus multiplies one of those sub-accounts by 6. How many dollars does that sub-account have now?

In the morning, a bookstore has 110 novels on its bestseller shelf, in a store that also sells 40 board games, unrelated to the book count. A wholesale shipment multiplies the shelf stock by 6. The stock is then split evenly among 3 display tables, and only one table's share is tracked from here. In the afternoon, 33 more novels are added to that table from a new release. By late afternoon, 17 more novels arrive. By evening, 19 more novels are placed on the table, a restocking round that takes 20 minutes, well under half an hour. How many novels are on that table by closing time?

A charity has 122 dollars raised from a bake sale, at an event that also sold 15 unrelated raffle tickets. The organizers split the funds evenly between two causes, and only one cause's half is tracked from here. Then 12 dollars are spent on printing thank-you cards. A matching donor adds 69 more dollars. A corporate sponsor then multiplies that cause's fund by 4. Afterward, 202 dollars are spent on event supplies for the cause. Finally, 76 more dollars come in from a late donation, deposited in just 10 minutes. How many dollars does that cause's fund have now?

In the morning, a farm has 151 chickens. A hatchery delivery multiplies the flock by 5. By midday, 29 more chickens are added from a neighboring farm. In the afternoon, a breeding program multiplies the flock by 7. By evening, a second breeding boost multiplies the flock by 4. Finally, 38 more chickens arrive from a late delivery, a trip that takes 90 minutes, or an hour and a half. How many chickens does the farm have now?

A stamp collector starts with 105 stamps in an album, in a house that also has 20 unrelated postcards on display. He trades away 50 stamps at a swap meet. A rare-find bonus multiplies his remaining stamps by 9. Then 94 stamps are damaged in a flood and discarded. A collectors' fair then multiplies what's left by 3. Finally, he receives 65 more stamps as a gift from a fellow collector. How many stamps does he have now?

A hardware store starts the day with 90 hammers on the shelf, in a store that has been open for half a century, unrelated to today's count. A shipment adds 44 more hammers. Then 60 hammers are sold to a construction crew. Another 8 hammers are returned as defective and pulled from stock. Finally, a distributor order multiplies the remaining hammers by 9. How many hammers does the store have now?
